claims: Dark is a German science fiction thriller.
Dark consists of 26 episodes across three seasons.
Dark's release dates are December 1, 2017 – June 27, 2020.
Baran bo Odar and Jantje Friese are the creator/showrunner of Dark.
Netflix is the streaming platform for Dark.
Dark follows four families entangled in a time-travel conspiracy across generations.
The premise of Dark is the disappearance of children in the small German town of Winden exposing fractured relationships and secrets spanning multiple generations.
Dark explores the impact of time travel on four families.
Characters in Dark are caught in a repeating cycle of misery.
Dark is designed to be a complete, self-contained puzzle.
Season 1 of Dark establishes the mystery and the initial time travel loops.
Season 2 of Dark deepens the conspiracy and introduces more complex timelines.
Season 3 of Dark concludes the series by exploring alternate worlds and resolving the time loop, as noted by Fandom.
